name: Conservative distinctive edit-neighbor token bank on the consumed producer-stratified panel
question: Can a single conservative branch recover the two observed safe UNKNOWNs using only high-confidence, roster-unique distinctive token evidence while retaining zero wrong-target matches?
observed_before_freeze: PS01 exposed high-confidence OCR token Colvados while the target token is calvados; the frozen exact token bank produced NO_MATCH.
PS02 exposed high-confidence Creche and p'tits while the target tokens include creche and petits; the frozen exact token bank observed only creche and des and produced NO_MATCH.

target_roster.entity_name: Département du Calvados - Direction de la Culture

name_token_contract.normalization: Unicode NFKD ASCII fold, lowercase alphanumeric tokens

distinctive_edit_token_contract.apostrophe_or_token_fragment_rule: For a row with two or three normalized tokens, also test their concatenation; this converts p + tits to ptits without changing OCR text.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.evidence_weighting: Each distinct matched target token of length 6-7 contributes one unit; length >=8 contributes two units. A target matches at two units.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.uniqueness_rule: Emit a lexical search-priority candidate only when exactly one target in the frozen eleven-target roster matches.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.association: Exact or Levenshtein-distance-one normalized token evidence only; witnesses union across the frozen three-frame reciprocal sequence.
distinctive_edit_token_contract.authority: Search-priority candidate only; no token, sign, facade, entity, portal, entrance, access, waypoint, arrival, or safety authority.

execution_rule: Run exactly once on the consumed panel. Do not tune this panel after observing the result. Any authority increase requires a separately frozen pixel- and OCR-unseen confirmation panel.

claim_boundary.allowed: Consumed Development mechanism evidence about whether a conservative, high-confidence, roster-unique exact-or-one-edit distinctive token branch explains and can recover the two already observed safe UNKNOWNs while preserving the sealed appearance fallback.
not_allowed: fresh, blind, independent, provider-disjoint, city-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, distribution-shift, deployment, or safety confirmation
a same-name or edit-neighbor OCR token proving exact physical identity, sign-to-building association, facade ownership, portal ownership, or entrance ownership
